summary: I started studying development in 2022 and working in the field in 2023. Since then, I have never stopped learning and understanding how to solve problems and build software — from architecture all the way to shipping to production. Today, I can confidently say I have experience across all phases of software development.
I am very curious and enjoy learning new things. I also like working in teams and adapting to new environments. I enjoy working with people who challenge me and help me grow professionally.

curiosities.text: My first contact was with Visualg, my first language was Python, but my main stack today is PHP and Go.
